title: Expansion of DENV stocks
author: Fabio Gomes
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.zu6f6ze
materials: Virus harvest and processing from Vero cell expansion

steps.title: Expansion of Cell Culture
steps.instruction: Warm culture media and TrypLE at 37oC TrypLE™ cell dissociation reagent Life Technologies Catalog #12605010

steps.title: Expansion of Cell Culture
steps.instruction: From a 25cm2 bottle, remove media, wash with 2mL PBS and add 2mL TrypLE

steps.title: Expansion of Cell Culture
steps.instruction: Incubate for 10-15 min 00:10:00

steps.title: Expansion of Cell Culture
steps.instruction: After 10 minutes incubation, inspect for cell dettachment at microscope Note: Some cell types might require pipetting of the cell media for complete dettachment.

steps.title: Expansion of Cell Culture
steps.instruction: Transfer dettached cells to a 225cm2 bottle containing 55 mL of cell media. Triturate against bottom of flask 8 - 10 times to break up cell clumps.

steps.title: Expansion of Cell Culture
steps.instruction: Incubate cell culture until they reach a confluence of 80-90%.

steps.title: Virus infection of Vero Cells for Expansion
steps.instruction: Check cell monolayer confluency. 80 – 90% confluency is optimal. Warm culture medium to 37°C.

steps.title: Virus infection of Vero Cells for Expansion
steps.instruction: Rapidly thaw virus stock vial in 37°C water bath. Vortex well to mix. Note: Transfer the virus on ice between the rooms

steps.title: Dilute virus to MOI 0.01
steps.instruction: Dilute virus in 5 mL of fresh culture medium to yield MOI = 0.01 (approximately 4 x 10 5 pfu of virus, assuming 3 – 4 x10 7 cells/flask). MOI can be 0.1 – 0.01 with little difference in final virus titer.

substeps.instruction: Add virus to 5 mL fresh culture medium to achieve MOI = 0.01 (≈4 × 10^5 pfu, assuming 3–4 × 10^7 cells per flask).
If desired, adjust MOI within the 0.1–0.01 range (little effect on final virus titer).

steps.title: Virus infection of Vero Cells for Expansion
steps.instruction: Remove medium from flask(s) to be infected.

steps.title: Virus infection of Vero Cells for Expansion
steps.instruction: Add 5 mL of virus dilution directly to cell monolayer. Rock flask back and forth to distribute inoculum.

steps.title: Virus infection of Vero Cells for Expansion
steps.instruction: Incubate flask at 32°C (or room temperature) for 5 – 10 min to maximize virus absorption. Rock flask back and forth occasionally. No need to remove inoculum. 00:10:00

steps.title: Virus infection of Vero Cells for Expansion
steps.instruction: Add 55 mL fresh culture medium to each flask.

steps.title: Virus infection of Vero Cells for Expansion
steps.instruction: Incubate 35 - 37°C, 5% CO 2 , 80% relative humidity for 5 – 6 days. Gently rock flask(s) each day if possible to maximize virus spread and final virus titer.

steps.title: Virus harvest and processing from Vero cell expansion
steps.instruction: Note: By day 5, some CPE may be visible, but such CPE is strain specific. In most cases, CPE is not visible, yet virus titers will be high. In fact, virus titer usually peaks before CPE becomes apparent. Because CPE is minimal, harvested virus fluid will contain few cells and does not require clarification.

steps.title: Virus harvest and processing from Vero cell expansion
steps.instruction: To each flask to be harvested, add 6 mL 10X SPG. Triturate with pipette to mix.

steps.title: Virus harvest and processing from Vero cell expansion
steps.instruction: Filter virus fluid through 0.2 mm PES (low protein binding) filter unit. This removes cells, breaks up virus clumps, and ensures bacterial sterility.

steps.title: Virus harvest and processing from Vero cell expansion
steps.instruction: Dispense virus fluid into labelled cryovials, 1.0 – 1.5 mL per tube.

steps.title: Virus harvest and processing from Vero cell expansion
steps.instruction: Flash freeze vials in dry ice for about 10 min.

steps.title: Store vials and re‑feed flasks
steps.instruction: Place vials in freezer inventory box and store at -70°C or below. After harvesting fluid, flask(s) can be re-fed with 60 mL fresh culture medium, returned to incubator, and re-harvested after two days. Repeat again if cell monolayer is intact. Virus titration is usually performed before utilization of the viruses

substeps.instruction: Place vials in freezer inventory box; store at ≤ ‑70 °C.
After harvesting fluid, add 60 mL fresh culture medium to each flask.
Incubate for 2 days, then re‑harvest fluid.
If cell monolayer remains intact, repeat the re‑feed/incubation cycle.
Perform virus titration before using the viruses.
